title: Clarify behavior when `Node` and `Resource` have required params in `_init`

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Fixes #104932
Fixes #108266
Fixes #102902

Tasks:

- [x] Add a supressable warning to GDScript to highlight _init functions on classes that extend from Node or Resource that contain required params. This warning should explain this behaviour, and stipulate that these objects can only be instantiated through code.
- [ ] Display a warning when creating instances of such classes (in the scene/inspector).
- [ ] Display a warning for any existing instances of such classes (in the scene/inspector).
- [ ] (Ensure these warnings are also visible for C# classes)
- [ ] ~~Display a warning for any code written to duplicate such classes.~~ (removed)
- [x] (Optimally) pause execution and highlight the offending _init function if attempting to execute them.
- [x] (ensure this is able to account for classes that inherit from such; except where they override _init)
- [x] (do not show this error for abstract classes; but do show for child classes that don't override _init)
- [x] Project Settings
- [x] Tests

Tests:
(+ = should show & planned; - = should not show & planned)

| | no _init (1) | no params (2) | only defaults (3) | only required (4) | any required (5) | required + abstract (6) | abstract + no _init (7) |
|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|--|
| Script extends Node/Resource (A) | - | - | - | + | + | - | |
| Script extends in-built sub-class of Node/Resource (B) | - | - | | | + | - | |
| Script extends a non-sub-class of Node/Resource (C) | | | | - | - | |
| Script extends A2 | - | - | - | | + | - | |
| Script extends A4 | + | - | | | + | - | - |
| Script extends A6 | + | - | | | + | - | - |
| Script extends A4~7 | + | - | | | | | |
| Script extends A6~7 | + | - | | | | | |
| Script extends B2 | - | - | | | + | - | |
| Script extends B5 | + | - | | | | | - |
| Script extends B5~7 | + | - | | | | | |
| Script extends C4 | | | | - | - | |

(Future tasks for separate PR)

- [ ] (Maybe) prevent loading of any scenes or resources that are/contain such classes.
